spans.s: गोवर्धन a grammarian who has writ- ten a work on Katantra Grammar called कातन्त्रकौमुदी and also a com- mentary on the Ganaratnamaho- dadhi of Vardhamana. A gloss on the Unadisutras is also assigned to Govardhana who is likely to be the same as above.
गोविन्द writer of a commentary known - as अम्बाकर्त्री by reason of that work beginning with the stanza अम्बा कर्त्रींó, on the Paribhasendusekhara of Nagesa.
गोविन्दराम writer of 'Sabdadipika,' a commentary on the Mugdha- bodha Vyakarana of Bopadeva.
